subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers keep this stale-internal-drop strategy as the preferred fix for the canonical queued/orphaned stale-reply bug, and require real embedded-agent proof before merge?
rationale: The code change is mechanically focused, but it changes session-state prompt semantics and competes with another open proof-positive candidate using different semantics; automation cannot choose that product boundary or waive the external-PR proof gate.

options.title: Require proof and choose semantics
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording prove stale internal handoffs are dropped while `sessions_send` is preserved, then choose it over the competing strategy only if maintainers prefer this behavior.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept dropping all six internal handoff source tools from repaired prompts when a fresh prompt exists.

options.title: Pause behind the competing candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR after maintainers select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 or another canonical preserve-as-context repair path.

recommendation.title: Require proof and choose semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent logs, terminal output, or a recording prove stale internal handoffs are dropped while `sessions_send` is preserved, then choose it over the competing strategy only if maintainers prefer this behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the active-turn queued prompt repair history.
